name: ap-sql-assistant
description: AP-SQL Assistant — Version 11.8. A careful restoration and enhancement release: V10.7.1 is the UI baseline (navbar, cards, 3D logo badge, signature, gradients restored, then professionally refined with a fluid 3D icon system), while the latest working functionality (Multiple Schema Store, V11.1 Stored/Active/Default/Inactive states, GitHub sync + encrypted vault, sync schedule, password management, CR builder, CASE/DECODE, Error Rectifier) remains the functional baseline — nothing was rolled back. New in V11.8: a schema-grounded AI Service Layer (Application -> AI Service Layer -> AI Provider -> Model) powers AI Self-Review of generated SQL, an AI Error Rectifier with an explicit AI Analysis step, AI-assisted query optimization, and a new AI Schema Assistant that answers questions strictly from schema metadata. The default provider is a fully local, deterministic engine that never invents schema objects, requires no API key, and keeps every non-AI workflow fully functional if AI is ever unavailable.
